stages.title: Complete no-record resource policy
notes: Default retain is unchanged; a forced no-record proof may only act on the caller's complete immutable set. Process discovery was removed; an incomplete or unobservable set is UNKNOWN.

stages.title: Independent birth and set verification
notes: Every resource is checked (pid/start/uid/argv/roots/parent) before the first signal and again fresh before each TERM/KILL; birth config/install/state must equal the request.

stages.title: Release only after a fixed-set observation
notes: Quiescence is an independent re-observation of the fixed pre-stop pids, never an empty array derived from a deleted record.

stages.title: First result: safe startup-phase tool
notes: Seventeen pure controls: own, wrong start, sibling, foreign child, mixed unknown, start window, refused stop, idempotence, birth root, child scope, no-record birth/exit/reuse/stop/unverified/set-mismatch/birth-config.
